description: January 8 march has no verified attendance estimate. Three arrests, five expelled leaders and UNTG workforce adherence are not crowd sizes.
required_followup: Recover event-specific reporting, photographs with defensible counts or organizer estimates; retain pending_threshold until established.

description: Contemporary January 28 reports conflict with Carta21 testimony printed in 2022 assigning detention of ten members to January 30. A date error or separate action remains unresolved.
required_followup: Compare original Carta21 records and dated contemporary local reporting. Do not create another action or reset the date from retrospective testimony alone.

description: January 8 and January 28 education actions share campaign links; VOA describes the latter as a second attempt within two weeks, which may imply an unidentified intermediate action.
required_followup: Recover intermediate chronology and the detailed Coding Procedure to decide distinct episodes, repeated local acts or phases without automatic daily splitting.

description: Neither documented march has an explicit physical episode closure. January 29 release is a custody outcome, not proof of assembly end.
required_followup: Locate actual dispersal completion or last physical action and resolve the episode before assigning end dates.

description: Several hundreds in MFWA clearly passes the qualitative 50-person threshold for January 28 but supplies no defensible numeric minimum/maximum. Other sources offer no competing contemporaneous crowd estimate.
required_followup: Retain qualitative evidence and null numeric bounds; check any additional independent crowd account and use the lower contemporaneous estimate if one conflicts.

description: Beatings on January 8 are alleged in the Capgb relay; January 28 activist beating is distinct from journalist assault. Dispersal and arrests are supported; shootings, killings, accommodation and ignore remain unknown.
required_followup: Trace original Capgb/RSM accounts and event-specific evidence. Do not convert allegations, journalist harm or absence of reported injuries into unsupported response fields.

description: DW attributes stone throwing against police on January 8 to an organizer account. The allegation is physical conduct against the state but has no independent corroboration here.
required_followup: Seek independent contemporaneous descriptions; preserve attribution and distinguish this from January 28, whose protester violence remains unknown.

description: January public-service strikes and recurring schedules do not establish a physical public gathering. Workforce adherence, holidays and return-to-work dates are not attendance or assembly closure.
required_followup: Find actual dated union rallies or street assemblies with attendance and state demands, then resolve national/local units and any December continuity.

description: The January 15 UNTG report announces a march for next Saturday. Intended date is ambiguous and execution is unverified.
required_followup: Recover the original Radio Sol Mansi broadcast or a dated follow-up proving actual assembly; keep start null until physical occurrence is established.

description: Drivers announced a January 17 stoppage in a January 8 report, citing an older ministerial agreement. No executed public gathering is verified.
required_followup: Find transport federation follow-up on execution, public gathering, attendance and event-specific state response. Do not date the candidate from the announcement or earlier agreement.

description: Retailers’ January 23 threat appears as a headline with embedded Radio Bantaba material. The video was not watched and assembly execution was not verified.
required_followup: Access and review the original accessible broadcast and follow-up reporting; record exact organization, physical occurrence, attendance and municipal demand without using headline alone as execution.

description: No Pintcha’s December Attadamum lead failed normal retrieval with HTTP 500 after browser cache miss. December grievances and strike announcements do not establish an eligible physical episode starting before January.
required_followup: Recover the December source through ordinary authorized access and establish any physical start before assigning a continuation owner. Do not fabricate a December continuation.

description: A January 28 student press conference called for a future Monday protest, corresponding to February 1. Actual February execution is not established.
required_followup: Search February follow-up in the neighboring month and link only an executed action after resolving campaign continuity.

description: ANG/RSM, Conosaba/RSM and Faladepapagaio/Capgb are relays. Repeated wording or shared agency origin does not provide independent corroboration.
required_followup: Trace original Radio Sol Mansi, Radio Bantaba and Capgb reports, preserve common origins and avoid counting syndicated pages as separate witnesses.

description: Public pages recovered by ordinary HTTPS after web cache misses. UN-hosted and UNILAB PDFs were read as extracted text; requested UN PDF screenshots failed. Many discovered URLs remain search_only.
required_followup: Verify relevant unopened bodies and rendered PDF pages when accessible. Keep search-only titles as discovery labels and do not claim layout verification or full archive access.

description: Portuguese search and reporting dominate. English MFWA supplies the clearest crowd description; French and limited Kriol queries gave sparse or neighboring-country results. Oral Kriol and other local-language radio archives were not comprehensively reviewed.
required_followup: Review original local broadcasts with competent language support and record any new evidence. Do not infer absence from sparse indexing.

description: Bissau is strongly represented. Searches included Bafatá, Gabú, Cacheu, Oio/Bissorã, Quínara/Buba, Bolama and Biombo/Quinhamel, but no additional January domestic protest was verified. Tombali and rural coverage remain particularly weak.
required_followup: Search regional/local archives and sector organizations, especially rural and poorly indexed areas, without equating failed retrieval with no events.

description: Sector searches covered education, public service, transport, markets, health, agriculture/cashew, women and opposition. No further eligible assembly was verified; customs grievances appeared as insufficiently resolved leads.
required_followup: Recover original January customs reporting and sector archives; distinguish press conferences and policy appointments from public anti-state gatherings.

description: Weekly date windows and after/before filters returned substantial wrong-year material, including 2026, 2025 and older stories. French searches also confused Guinea with Guinea-Bissau.
required_followup: Manually check dates and countries in every retained body; repeat archive-specific January weekly searches where date filters failed. Logged results are not exhaustive search totals.

description: This is an open-web pass. LexisNexis, the official MM baseline and the detailed original Coding Procedure were unavailable; original inclusion and duplicate status cannot be verified.
required_followup: Obtain the authorized official baseline and procedure, compare candidates with existing events and perform independent review before any official inclusion.
